title: Agent has no self-knowledge of its own runtime
why_selected: This is a current open issue with a clean expected-vs-actual context boundary.
reproduction_summary: Issue input simulation: Fresh sessions can conflate Hermes-Agent with unrelated Hermes entities because runtime identity docs are on disk but not in context.
expected_behavior: A fresh session can identify that it is running inside NousResearch/hermes-agent and load relevant framework context without web or terminal recovery.
failure_mode: The agent may answer from name-matched priors, then only correct itself after the user provides the repository URL or terminal evidence.
notes: live_github_issue. Issue was opened May 12, 2026 and is still open in the browsed GitHub page.

title: hermes mcp add silently launches chat instead of registering MCP server
why_selected: The issue is directly about a state transition mismatch from parsed command to dispatcher route.
reproduction_summary: Issue input simulation: The --command flag on the mcp add subparser clobbered the top-level argparse command, causing dispatch to fall through to chat.
expected_behavior: hermes mcp add should dispatch to MCP registration and preserve the user-facing --command flag.
failure_mode: The command silently launched interactive chat because args.command was overwritten to None.
notes: github_issue_closed_by_pr. PR #21204 says it closes #19785 and records 35/35 validation tests passing.

title: Gateway creates AIAgent with empty OpenRouter API key when fallback providers exist
why_selected: This issue has detailed expected behavior, actual behavior, root cause, and affected files.
reproduction_summary: Issue input simulation: Gateway runtime provider resolution passed an empty OpenRouter API key into AIAgent and skipped fallback providers.
expected_behavior: Gateway should detect the empty OpenRouter key and either emit a clear missing-key error or fall through to configured fallback providers.
failure_mode: Gateway returns a generic RuntimeError about no LLM provider configured.
notes: live_github_issue. GitHub page marks the issue closed, but it remains a strong regression input.

title: mcp_serve external tool parameters accept malformed numeric limits
why_selected: The linked PR includes live bug repros and a compact repair strategy.
reproduction_summary: Issue input simulation: External-facing MCP tool parameters such as limit, timeout_ms, and cursor values could be strings/floats/bad values and raise TypeError.
expected_behavior: Numeric external tool parameters should coerce, clamp, or default safely before slicing or min/max operations.
failure_mode: Inputs like string limits, bad strings, floats, and None in min operations could raise TypeError.
notes: github_issue_closed_by_pr. PR #21329 states live repro on main and 84/84 tests passing after the fix.

title: Cron should skip AI call when prerun script produces no output
why_selected: Empty output is a common issue class for agent workflows and maps cleanly to expected-vs-actual tracing.
reproduction_summary: Issue input simulation: A cron prerun script can produce no output; the desired behavior is to avoid an unnecessary AI call on empty input.
expected_behavior: Cron should detect empty prerun output and skip the AI call or surface an explicit empty-output state.
failure_mode: Without the guard, the cron path can continue into an AI call despite no useful input.
notes: github_pr_regression. The browsed item is a PR, so this task is PR-regression input rather than a standalone issue body.

title: Enable secret redaction by default
why_selected: Instrumentation must compete safely; redaction is a precondition for a usable dashboard database.
reproduction_summary: Issue input simulation: Release evidence links default secret redaction work to PRs #17691, #20785, and #21193.
expected_behavior: Debug, trace, and shared outputs should redact token-like values by default.
failure_mode: Without default redaction, diagnostic surfaces risk exposing credential-shaped values.
notes: release_linked_security_pr. Release page was used as evidence because the direct PR body was not needed for this safety fixture.

title: Exception Event loop is closed after vision_analyze first call or chained tool calls
why_selected: The issue is a real closed bug with local regression-test coverage and a clear runtime lifecycle boundary.
reproduction_summary: Issue input simulation: Issue #2104 reports event-loop lifecycle failure after vision_analyze is used as the first call or in chained tool calls.
expected_behavior: Tool calls should not leave closed async clients or event loops that fail later in the same chat session.
failure_mode: A later operation can encounter an 'Event loop is closed' exception after vision/chained tool usage.
notes: github_issue_regression. Verified with gh issue view on May 13, 2026; issue is closed and labeled type/bug.
